items.question: What divine attributes characterize this member among the twelve Adityas?
premises: The described form is endless in nature.
The described form possesses four arms.
The described form is gentle and adorned with all ornaments.
items.inference: This member of the twelve Adityas is defined by an endless, four-armed, gentle, and fully adorned divine form.
